opening.argument: The video is centered on Pexo.ai as a practical AI video-creation tool: it is introduced as a beta product that “completely flips how you make videos,” while the dashboard breaks prompts into scenes, proposes structures, and shows previews. The demonstrated workflow also lets users comment on a specific frame so Pexo fixes that part, showing operational editing rather than a financial-return scheme. Access is provided through a Gmail account, invite code, free-tier credits, and credits earned by sharing, with a free invite link in the description. Separate promotional-review and traffic or ranking discussions are presented as marketing services with non-financial-advice and non-solicitation disclaimers.

citations.quote: It's called Pexo AI. It's in Beta right now and it completely flips how you make videos.
Pexo immediately started thinking out loud on the dashboard. It broke the idea into scenes, proposed a structure, suggested visual styles, and showed different, quick previews.
On the web preview, you can circle a specific frame, leave a comment like you would in a Google doc, and Pexo fixes just that part.
Free Tier gives you a solid amount of Credits when you sign-up, and you can earn more by sharing.
It's in beta so you need a Gmail and an invite code to get in.
